stories.title: MoD signs ₹810.79 crore SAT-SAAW deal with BDL
stories.body: contract signed 23 Sept 2026 with Bharat Dynamics Ltd for 160 Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons (SAT-SAAW) for the IAF under Buy Indian (IDDM), in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh; DRDO-designed precision glide bomb with 60% indigenous content; will arm Jaguar, Hawk and Su-30MKI aircraft; deliveries from 2027-28 to 2028-29.

stories.title: DRDO's 30kW laser anti-drone weapon moves toward production
stories.body: DRDO is taking its indigenous 30kW-class truck-mounted laser weapon toward production and will seek an industry partner; it engages drone swarms and UAVs up to 5 km; part of Project Sudarshan Chakra, with 50kW and 100kW classes in the works.

stories.title: Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026 (22nd edition)
stories.body: India–US troops held joint artillery drills at Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan, on 23 Sept with M777 ultra-light howitzers, Dhanush guns, Pinaka MBRLs, L70 air-defence guns and M-LIDS, focused on interoperability of fire planning and coordination; the exercise is being held across Rajasthan and Uttarakhand.

stories.title: Tata's defence plant inaugurated in Berrechid, Morocco
stories.body: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Morocco's Defence Minister Abdelatif Loudyi inaugurated TASL's 20,000 sq-m facility on 23 Sept, which will build 150 WhAP 8x8 armoured vehicles for the Royal Moroccan Army over three years — the biggest contract for Indian-made armoured vehicles.

stories.title: SEBI Board meets 24 Sept with major reforms on the agenda
stories.body: overhaul of PMS regulations including a new mutual-fund-only PMS (minimum investment ~₹25 lakh vs ₹50 lakh; minimum net worth ~₹2 crore vs ₹5 crore), a common advertisement code for regulated entities, settlement regulation changes, eased FPI norms for non-agri commodity derivatives, corporate debt reforms (Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities), depository receipts for REITs/InvITs, and vault-manager rules.

stories.title: SEBI's net-settlement proposal: comments close 24 Sept
stories.body: SEBI's 3 Sept consultation paper proposes net settlement of funds (with gross securities settlement) for mutual-fund cash-market trades, only at individual scheme level; public comments invited till 24 Sept 2026.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal gets SEBI nod for custodial services
stories.body: Motilal Oswal Custodial Services received SEBI approval on 24 Sept to offer custodial services (safekeeping, trade settlement, corporate actions, regulatory reporting) to institutional clients including AIFs, portfolio managers, mutual funds, insurers and pension funds; operations begin Q4 2026.

stories.title: 3-day nationwide bank strike from 28 Sept 2026
stories.body: United Forum of Bank Unions (UFBU, seven unions covering ~90% of the banking workforce) called a strike for 28–30 Sept; SBI advised customers to finish branch work by 25 Sept, while ATMs, YONO, internet/mobile banking and UPI stay functional; demands include a 5-day banking week, pension updation, a uniform DA formula and an NPS-to-OPS switch option; a continuous strike from 26 Oct was also announced.

stories.title: PIB Fact Check busts fake UPI/ATM rumours
stories.body: on 23 Sept the Finance Ministry clarified: UPI P2P stays free, merchant payments up to ₹2,000 stay free, and a 0.4% MDR applies only on specified person-to-merchant transactions above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 for transactions of ₹75,000 and above; ~96% of merchant transactions remain unaffected.

stories.title: EPFO wage ceiling raised to ₹25,000
stories.body: Cabinet approval of 16 Sept, effective 17 Sept 2026 (Vishwakarma Jayanti): mandatory EPF coverage ceiling raised from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month, the first revision in ~12 years (since Sept 2014); ~51 lakh additional employees expected under coverage; annual government outgo ~₹11,339 crore.

stories.title: RBI rate-hike buzz returns
stories.body: repo has stayed at 5.25% since August (fourth straight pause); MPC next meets 5–7 Oct; S&P expects one 25-bps hike to 5.5% in FY27, Fitch expects 5.5% in October and then 5.75% in early 2027, and SBI Research also recommends two hikes.

stories.title: India co-sponsors inaugural P4M Summit at the UN
stories.body: on 21 Sept in New York, EAM S. Jaishankar co-chaired the first-ever 'Partners for Multilateralism, International Law, Peace & Prosperity (P4M)' Summit with leaders of Australia, Barbados, Brazil, Canada and Kenya; he stressed transparent decision-making and action on the '4F' crisis of fuel, food, fertiliser and finance.

stories.title: WION Iconic Tourism Summit & Awards 2026
stories.body: held 23 Sept at ITC Maurya, New Delhi, presented by VFS Global in association with Red Hat Communications; sessions on the future of global mobility, biometric travel and AI in tourism, concluding with the Iconic Awards 2026 for travel and tourism contributors.

stories.title: Roshibina Devi wins wushu silver
stories.body: on 24 Sept, Naorem Roshibina Devi lost the women's 60kg sanda final 0-2 to China's Zhang Xiaoyu and took silver — she is the first Indian to win medals at three successive Asian Games (bronze 2018, silver at Hangzhou 2022, silver 2026); India's tally now stands at 14 (1 gold, 6 silver, 7 bronze).

stories.title: Satnam Singh & Salman Khan row to bronze
stories.body: on 24 Sept the Indian pair won bronze in men's double sculls (6:13.25), finishing behind China and Uzbekistan.

stories.title: Five medals on Day 4 (23 Sept)
stories.body: Mirabai Chanu won silver in women's 49kg weightlifting (total 198 kg: 87 snatch + 111 clean & jerk), ending India's 28-year wait since Karnam Malleswari's 1998 Bangkok silver; Jay Meena won bronze in men's singles soft tennis — India's first-ever Asian Games medal in soft tennis; bronzes also came in men's and women's skeet team events and the men's badminton team (lost 1-3 to China in the semifinal).

stories.title: Elena Rybakina wins US Open women's singles
stories.body: on 12 Sept, Elena Rybakina (Kazakhstan) beat Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final, denying her a three-peat; Rybakina's third Grand Slam title (Australian Open 2026, Wimbledon 2022).

stories.title: World Maritime Day — 24 September
stories.body: UN/IMO observance held on the last Thursday of September; 2026 theme "From Policy to Practice: Powering Maritime Excellence" — the first two-year theme (2026–27), endorsed by the IMO Council at its 134th session (7–11 July); focuses on implementing maritime regulations through technical assistance and training.

stories.title: Ayushman Bharat turns 8
stories.body: on 23 Sept PM Modi said 60+ crore beneficiaries now have ₹5 lakh annual health cover, making it the world's largest healthcare scheme; 48.54 crore Ayushman cards created, 13+ crore availed treatment, ₹2+ lakh crore of care through 38,000+ empanelled hospitals; Ayushman Arogya Mandirs recorded 500+ crore visits.

stories.title: 20th Rozgar Mela
stories.body: on 19 Sept PM Modi distributed 51,000+ appointment letters at 45 locations (~12.75 lakh total through Rozgar Melas); he highlighted the new Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (~₹1 lakh crore outlay, ~2 crore first-time youth, ₹15,000 incentive to first-time job seekers plus incentives to employers).

stories.title: Exercise Veer Guardian 2026 concludes at Jodhpur
stories.body: the 2nd edition of the IAF–Japan Air Self-Defence Force (JASDF) bilateral air exercise concluded on 22 Sept 2026 at Air Force Station Jodhpur after 14 days of joint training; the IAF deployed Su-30MKI, Rafale and the indigenous LCA Tejas while the JASDF brought F-2A fighters — the first-ever visit of Japanese fighter aircraft to India; on Distinguished Visitor's Day, JASDF Chief of Staff Gen. Takehiro Morita and IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh both flew the Tejas; the inaugural edition was held at Hyakuri Air Base, Japan, in January 2023.

stories.title: Fitch, S&P and ADB raise India's FY27 GDP forecast
stories.body: on 23 Sept, Fitch Ratings raised India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.9% (from 6.4%) and S&P Global Ratings to 7% (from 6.6%), following stronger-than-expected 7.8% growth in the June quarter; the Asian Development Bank also raised its forecast to 7% (from 6.6%); all three agencies expect at least a 25-bps RBI rate hike — Fitch sees 5.5% in October and 5.75% in early 2027, while S&P projects FY27 consumer inflation averaging 5.1%.

stories.title: Luke Lindberg appointed WFP Executive Director
stories.body: on 18 Sept the UN appointed US agriculture official Luke Lindberg as Executive Director of the World Food Programme, on the joint recommendation of UN Secretary-General António Guterres and FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu after Executive Board confirmation; he succeeds Cindy McCain (Deputy ED Carl Skau had served as acting ED) for a five-year term, becoming the youngest person ever to lead the agency; Lindberg was previously USDA Under Secretary for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs and was nominated for the role by US President Donald Trump; WFP is headquartered in Rome and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2020.

stories.title: India becomes first South Asian country to host WCEF
stories.body: the World Circular Economy Forum 2026 (15–18 Sept) was inaugurated at the Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, by Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav and Gujarat CM Bhupendrabhai Patel; theme: "Circular Economy: Transition for People and Prosperity"; organised by the Central Pollution Control Board with the Finnish Innovation Fund Sitra, the MoEFCC and the Government of Gujarat.

stories.title: ISRO–ESA cooperative agreement extended to 8 January 2032
stories.body: the pact now covers wider collaboration on space weather and human/robotic exploration; in parallel, India's National Quantum Mission is expanding, with C-DOT's 14 indigenous quantum products and IISc Bengaluru's Foundation for Quantum Computing Innovation among recent milestones.

stories.title: ISTRAC's Advanced Radar Research Facility to come up in Assam
stories.body: the new ISRO IARRF facility at Chandrapur, Assam will strengthen satellite tracking, telemetry and command capabilities from the Northeast, supporting the growing launch cadence including Gaganyaan and navigation-satellite missions.

stories.title: 9th Molecular Virology Meeting (MVM 2026) at New Delhi
stories.body: the meeting concluded on 18 Sept at BRIC–National Institute of Immunology (BRIC-NII), New Delhi, bringing together ~200 clinicians, researchers and students on viral biology, vaccines, therapeutics and public health; initiated in 2009, this annual virology forum was hosted with support from ICGEB and the Regional Centre for Biotechnology.

stories.title: MY Bharat crosses 3 crore registered youth
stories.body: the platform, launched in 2023, has now crossed 3 crore registered users.

stories.title: Bharat Taxi launched in five UP cities
stories.body: on 23 Sept CM Yogi Adityanath flagged off the cooperative-led ride-hailing service in Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Varanasi, Kanpur and Prayagraj; the platform runs on a "Driver is the Owner" cooperative model with zero commission (operated by Sahakar Taxi Cooperative Ltd); ~40,000 drivers ("Saarthis") registered across the five cities, while nationally 10+ lakh Saarthis have joined since the service began in February 2026.

stories.title: UP's Krishak Samriddhi Yojana portal and two apps launched
stories.body: at the same 23 Sept programme, the CM launched the Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana e-portal (long-term farm loans through the UP Cooperative Rural Development Bank now at 6% interest, down from 11%; targets 5 lakh small and marginal farmers), the Urvarak Setu mobile app of the Cooperation Department and the UPCDC app of the UP Cooperative Database Centre.

stories.title: India's solar capacity nears 165 GW
stories.body: PM Surya Ghar has so far empowered 51+ lakh families, as India's installed solar capacity rose to nearly 165 GW.

stories.title: Rajat Sharma re-elected NBDA President
stories.body: the News Broadcasters & Digital Association board unanimously re-elected India TV Chairman & Editor-in-Chief Rajat Sharma as President for 2026-27 at its meeting on 23 Sept; the NBDA is the apex association of 29 leading news broadcasters comprising 130+ news channels and digital platforms; Jayant Mammen Mathew (MM TV) joined the board.

stories.title: BJP appoints in-charges for 36 states and UTs
stories.body: on 24 Sept the party named state in-charges and co-in-charges: national general secretary Smriti Irani gets Haryana and Chhattisgarh, and vice-president Ram Madhav gets Tamil Nadu and Uttarakhand.
